# Authenticator

Status: **Partly built** · Section: Safety, locks, and authentication · [All features](README.md)

## What is there

src/server/totp.ts (RFC 6238 SHA-1, 6 digits), tests/totp.test.ts, main.ts `totpPanel`

## What is missing

a built-in authenticator destination for arbitrary secrets (current code is only second-step sign-in); SHA-256/SHA-512, 8 digits, custom periods; QR/image/clipboard import; countdown and next-code peek; OS vault storage; secrets export behind super confirmation
